name: Carla Lam
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I still remember a client apologizing to an empty chair.” On Wednesday, near the entrance to the Wash House, Carla stops for local notices even on a day without a load to wash.
voice: I was his lawyer. He never once asked me to wipe out this particular debt.
appearance: Carla has black hair twisted into a small knot, a deep crease beside the mouth when smiling, and a favorite piece of clothing, a soft blue checked shirt. It usually goes with a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light. When somebody else has the floor, Carla looks at people's hands before looking at what they carry.
personality: Is a careful borrower and a reckless lender. Things leave this person's house with elaborate instructions and very little expectation of ever coming back.
agenda: To preserve the one bill the client never disputed.
family: Denise Emery is Carla’s cousin. Carla offers the first invitation. Denise gets to change the plan. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *Two left slippers*, Denise says, “I ticked footwear present on the form. I have added a chair where people can actually try the pair.”
connections: Karen Pierce. A date on the old bill belongs in the lawyer's account of the unclaimed debt.

reactions.situation: The deli is asked to publish the whole tab
reactions.response: Carla asks who owns the personal information on the tab before any of it leaves the counter.

reactions.situation: A friend asks for a loan due back before payday
reactions.response: Carla asks which other bill repayment would displace, then offers only what the household can afford to give.

reactions.response: Carla listens first to the account of how it was actually used.
